primitive: Linux ONLY pinned os.Root.Link staging->destination, never Rename or truncating existing files. Existing common cacheownership.Acquire on custody logical basename held through all operations/Close. Go1.26 stdlib os/root.go235 exposes Root.Link; os/root_openat.go277 implements root-relative linkat without replacement. Filesystem lack of hardlink/fsync support is a refusal, never a fallback.

layout.bundle: Explicit custody absolute path. Immutable canonical0600 file contains schema, endpoint origin, canonical token metadata WITHOUT locator/secret (locatorSHA256 only), credentialTTLSeconds, generated credentialID/keyID, Ed25519 private64/public32, EXACT raw enrollment Request bytes. Key+request one file, no two-file atomicity gap.
layout.receipt: Same pinned parent, derived .zasp-gateway-enrollment-<SHA256(custody_basename)>.receipt. Immutable canonical0600 strict receipt bound to original request; no secret. A current signed authority observation, if supported, is separate .authority artifact with distinct schema and cannot substitute enrollment receipt.
layout.staging: Each final artifact has a deterministic sibling .zasp-publish-<SHA256(logical_final_basename)>.prepare; no arbitrary glob scan/cleanup, randomstage or deleting unrelated files. Both stage/final share same pinned parent.
layout.export: Explicit absolute runtime credential destination with separately pinned actual parent and common cacheownership guard for that basename held during publication. Exact existing canonical JSON {credential_id,key_id,private_key}. Refuse export path equal/alias custody,receipt,authority,stage or lock artifacts. Different lock acquisition order must be fixed: custody first, export second; no inverse caller APIs.

publish_protocol: Under held valid guard, inspect stage/final with Lstat: no symlink, currentUID, regular, exact0600, bounded expected bytes. Existing files never opened WRONLY/TRUNC or chmod/chown. Refuse unexpected inode/linkcount or mismatched existing content.

If neither exists, create deterministic stage O_WRONLY|O_CREATE|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW0600, require descriptor regular0600/currentUID/nlink1 and same current pathname. Write complete canonical bytes, file.Sync, check write/close errors; root.Open(".").Sync persists stage directory entry. A partial/unknown stage is retained, not removed or overwritten.

Validate stage exact bytes+canonical schema+private/public/request consistency via bounded rooted FD/path checks; Root.Link(stage,final) exclusive. If final already exists, inspect as recovery below, never overwrite. After link verify both names reference same originally validated inode, now exactly2links.

Sync parent directory after link. Remove ONLY validated same-inode deterministic stage (never final), then Sync parent directory again. Final must now regular0600/currentUID/nlink1, exact byte readback; check Guard.Valid. Only after all success may HTTP occur or export be reported durable.

On ANY failure preserve key-bearing paths; close FDs/guards normally; report unresolved generic error, never send before durable initial bundle. Do not remove stage on write/link/sync/close failure. Retrying reestablishes durability of valid exact existing state; errors never mean never-committed.

recovery_states.ABSENT: Neither custody bundle nor stage exists. Create new one only after full source/token/config validation and sole-owner lock. Generate ID/key/expiry once inside this branch.
recovery_states.PREPARED_ONLY: Stage exists, final absent. Validate complete original bundle. If valid, fsync existing stage+directory and finish same Root.Link publication; do not generate new key/ID/expiry. Partial/malformed/foreign/unsafe stage => UNRESOLVED_CUSTODY; no deletion or network.
recovery_states.LINKED_BOTH: Stage+final same inode, both exact expected bytes, nlink2. Resync file+directory, remove only owned stage, resync directory/readback; continue original state. Different inode/content or unexpected links => UNRESOLVED_CUSTODY; retain both.
recovery_states.PENDING: Durable valid bundle final only/nlink1, no receipt. Existing source bundle+endpoint+TTL/tokenlocator digest must match original; original raw request/key/expiry reused regardless current Now. Network/commit ambiguity remains PENDING; no key/intent replacement.
recovery_states.ACCEPTED: Durable strict matching enrollment receipt final. Replayed boolean can differ on later exact network retry; compare all immutable fields and retain first durable receipt unchanged. Do not pretend replayed=false means first-ever commit. No further enrollment call required for export.
recovery_states.EXPORTED: ACCEPTED plus exact runtime credential output durable. Repeated export only validates identical canonical bytes+ownership and resyncs; differing existing output is conflict, no overwrite. Receipt/export stage recovery uses exactly same exclusive-link protocol.
recovery_states.UNRESOLVED: Unsafe, malformed, partial, inconsistent file or expired/revoked token with unknown enrollment result. Preserve key/material. No automatic repair, delete, rollback, identity regeneration or secret reissue. Explicit status may separately verify current signed authority and store distinct .authority evidence; never label it original enrollment receipt.

Prepare compares original endpoint/TTL and token metadata/digest on retry, not recomputed current expiry. Initial expiry wholeUTC Now+boundedTTL<=90days; generation from authoritative protected bundle.
custody_export_API.scope_choice: First connected implementation export requires durable bound enrollment receipt ONLY. Current-authority status/export path is later explicit extension; no permissive alternate in this first API.

limits: Hardlink publish semantics apply cooperating current binaries on existing trusted same-filesystem Linux directory; malicious parent/sameUID/old binaries not isolated.
No ordinary Rename, forcedoverwrite, chmod/chown, secret stdout or simulated filesystem success fallback.
